name: Boxes
description: Boxes in the prompt for a model that takes them (FLUX 3 Image, Ideogram 4, FLUX 3 Image Klein on your ComfyUI): where an element goes, which one stays, moves or is removed, which reference layer is placed where, words to render. A canvas tool (X) that draws, moves and resizes them, a panel in the Generate pane, Selection → box, Copy rows, and the commands boxes.add / set / remove / list / check / from_selection / clear for scripts and agents. The boxes are saved with the document and sent with a run of a recipe that takes them while the Boxes switch under the prompt is on (the first box turns it on).
author: Scumble
